notes: Case temperature: c-temp 0°C to +70°C (FTCD4543E3PxM per Section VI); limited temp 20°C to +60°C per product features. Average launch power min -1.9 dBm and average receive power min -8.2 dBm are informative per IV notes. Receiver sensitivity (OMAouter) max -6.1 dBm for TECQ<1.4 dB; for 1.4 dB ≤ TECQ ≤ 3.4 dB sensitivity is -7.5 + TECQ dBm. Stressed receiver sensitivity -4.1 dBm (OMAouter) measured with SECQ 3.4 dB conformance test at TP3 per IEEE 124.8.9. Electrical signaling rate per lane 26.5625±100 ppm Gbd; optical per lane 53.125±100 ppm GBd. Bit Error Ratio 2.4E-4 as defined by IEEE P802.3bs. Maximum distance SMF per G.652 Lmax1 10,000 m.
